summary.headline: Vikram Solar Q1 FY27: record 1,006 MW volume (+32% YoY) and revenue ~INR1,563 cr, but EBITDA fell to INR126 cr (8.06% margin) as costs outran pass-through.
summary.overview: Revenue rose about 8% QoQ and 38% YoY to roughly INR1,563 crore on 1.06 GW dispatched, with per-watt realisation up 8% QoQ to INR15.02/Wp on DCR mix. EBITDA was INR126 crore (8.06% margin) and PAT INR19.78 crore, as unit COGS rose INR1.86/Wp from metals, EVA, and cell costs that were only partly passed through. Management attributed the squeeze to ALMM-2 uncertainty, Gulf-conflict input inflation, and industry oversupply. It declined to give fresh FY27 guidance, deferring the update to H1 results, and the Gangaikondan module plant (first module 29 June) and cell plant (Q4 FY27) remain on schedule.

financial_highlights.change: Down sharply; prior-quarter level referenced as ~16%

financial_highlights.value: 76 MW (cited as ~75 MW later on call)

segments.name: Module – large accounts / IPP / utility / C&I (non-DCR)
segments.commentary: Base-load book of ~7.1 GW with tighter margins; management says pass-through under MSAs applies to cells only, not balance-of-materials. Price realisation for mid-market expected ~INR0.50/Wp higher.

segments.name: Module – DCR
segments.commentary: 76 MW sold in Q1 at materially higher realisation (DCR ~INR22+/Wp per management). Cell supply is from external domestic partners until own cell line starts; DCR volume expected to grow 2–2.5x each quarter.

segments.name: Distribution channel
segments.commentary: Monthly run rate roughly doubled from ~40 MW last year; network of 119+ distributors and 757+ dealers across 24 states. Management says distribution pricing is spot-linked and realises INR1–1.5/Wp above key accounts.

segments.name: BESS (VSL PowerHive)
segments.commentary: 7.5 GWh BESS assembly plant in Chennai: equipment ordered ~3 months ago, delivery Nov 2026, installation Jan 2027, COD from March 2027. First 20 MWh utility-scale order executed; 7.5 GWh LFP cell plant (Phase 1 of 15 GWh) targets COD Q4 FY29, with land and incentives expected by Sept 2026.

guidance_outlook: No updated FY27 guidance; management will revisit at H1 results. Prior FY27 outlook (given 8 May) referenced as including EBITDA of INR1,500–1,600 crore per an analyst's citation; management did not reaffirm it.
Q2 margins expected to remain under some pressure from unabsorbed prices, partly offset by DCR and channel mix; management declined to say whether 16% margin returns.
Gangaikondan cell line (9 GW) on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27, with ramp possibly spilling into Q1 FY28; FY28 cell utilisation targeted at 40–50% (six-month ramp).
Wafer-ingot capacity resized to 9 GW (from 6 GW, part of the 12 GW plan), project cost ~INR5,600 crore; ground-breaking announced for next month.
Capex of ~INR5,000 crore planned for FY27 and similar in FY28; funding targeted at 75:25 debt-equity, ~70:30 once scheme is in place.
capex_capacity: Gangaikondan: 6 GW module (commissioned 29 June 2026, fully funded); module capacity cited as 15.5 GW total across sites, with 9–9.5 GW expected to be deliverable in FY27.
Gangaikondan 9 GW cell plant: civil/PEB advanced, first cell targeted Q4 FY27; ~70% backward integration once live.
Gangaikondan 9 GW wafer/ingot: board approved increase from 6 GW to 9 GW; part of the 12 GW plan, project cost ~INR5,600 crore; phasing shifted with later capacity around FY29.
Earlier 3 GW cell phase kept for FY28 on upgraded (non-TOPCon) technology.
Module portfolio transitioned from M10R to G12R; manpower down ~40% on new automated lines. Production volume in Q1 about 1,085 MW.
demand_pricing: Management attributes weak Q1 order flow to ALMM-2 enforcement uncertainty (C&I 15 GW/yr demand waited); ALMM-2 deferred to December 2026 after the 18 July operating memorandum.
Pricing power in non-DCR is under pressure from oversupply (~210 GW cited); cell oversupply limited pass-through of cost escalation.
Analyst estimate: industry DCR demand revised down to ~17 GW for the year from 20–25 GW as C&I shifts to non-DCR.
Chinese landed cell price cited at ~4 cents/W before 27.5% BCD.
Tender pipeline: ~35–40 GW of fresh utility tenders post-August 2025; FY27 AC market estimated at 30–35 GW utility, ~15 GW C&I, 14–15 GW PM Surya Ghar plus KUSUM.
